sentences.text: JUDGMENT Learned counsel for the appellants filed a memo seeking permission to withdraw the appeal as dispute between the parties is already settled.
Memo is placed on record.
In view of the memo, appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
Court fee on the appeal is ordered to be refunded in accordance with law.
